colour_cycle._note: s128, FS-UAE + static read: the overworld water shimmers. h77 +0x178 (called from the input wait loop h80 +0x1ac while no IDCMP message waits) rotates the three colour words h78 +6 / +8 / +a (08B, 08A, 26A) every 200000 us of CurrentTime (h80 +0xd2a, h78 +2 = 0x30D40) and SetRGB4s them into pens h78 +0xc = 4, 7, 14: the colour of pen 4 moves to 7, 7 to 14, 14 to 4. On only between h62 +0 (h2 +0x196, the wilderness) and h62 +0xa (town, dungeon, other states). 0.2 s = 12 VBL at 60 Hz here (a wall-clock timer, not VBLs; 60 because the pack's title, combat and sound layouts take this vbl_hz when they name none, and I is NTSC as its victory screen and title tune); measured on FS-UAE ~0.22 s a step (the loop polls it). runs_while input_wait (s153): h77 +0x178's only caller is h80 +0x1ac, so it pauses while anything else runs (a requester-23 box, an h86 requester, a step); on the next idle poll it takes one step at once when 0.2 s have passed since the last (no catching up), and h80 +0xd2a keeps CurrentTime's seconds mod 8 (clock_wrap_seconds: a step comes early at each multiple).

title_sequence._note: The Amiga boot (reverse-engineering/amiga/FORMAT.md 'Title' and 'Title tune'): s/startup-sequence runs game; main (hunk 2 +0x38) calls h77 +0x2de: cover1 is blitted, palette h69 +0xb4 set, tamb.dat (the title tune) plays until it ends or a key / mouse button (IDCMP RAWKEY / MOUSEBUTTONS, h80 +0x4e4) stops it [C]. tamb.dat is an ST Dosound script read by the Amiga player h89 +0x304 (Paula, a 16-byte ramp waveform, Delay(n*6/5) ticks of 1/50 s): 338 steps, 2678 ticks = 53.56 s [C], so cover1 lasts the tune (a key ends both). Its period factor 1.7897732 is the NTSC Paula clock over the ST PSG clock, so clock_hz is NTSC [~]. Then cover2 (credits) and main's Delay(250) = 5 s (dos.library ticks are 1/50 s on PAL and NTSC) [C]; the Amiga ignores keys there, the remaster lets a key end it.

ending_scene._note: The victory screen (h32 +0x6d0, s127 static; FORMAT.md 'Defeat and ending pictures'): final.pic blitted on black, the 16 pens of the combat table h69 +0x94 (x17) set one at a time 10 WaitTOF apart (h77 +0x288), Delay(120); the ghost (h69 +0x994) in each OK member's slot of the row at y 158 (h32 +0x36e: n OK members, gap (320 - 32n)/(n + 1); a slot's x is that of the next OK member, the ghosts go to slots 0..n-1), Zeus' raised arm (h69 +0x3694, 32x37) at (160, 48); per OK member its portrait over its slot and Delay(120); the 7 speech lines centred on row 192 in pen 5 (h80 +0x84a), each 180 ticks or a key (h62 +0x576); then pens 15..0 to black (the summoned elemental: the Amiga's loops take every record, DOS and the remaster at most 6 [~]), 10 WaitTOF apart. VBL rate 60 Hz (NTSC) [~], as the title tune. Sounds (s128, sounds below, sound_effects): 22 before the black, 25 on black before the fade-in, 1 between the ghosts and the arm, 21 after each portrait, 24 and 22 between the last line and the fade-out; the player h89 +0x304 blocks, so each holds the screen for its length [C] (s130 live capture: the screen is cleared to pen 0 before sound 22, as the remaster [C]; the disk read / guild.dat write times, the per-step sound overhead, FORMAT.md). s130 live capture (reverse-engineering/amiga/working/capture_s130_victory.md): a line is 180 polls of Delay(1) + a port check, 21.87 ms each (3.93 s) [C]; disk waits [~] (head position, patched path): final.pic read 3.45 s after sound 22, guild.dat written 5.95 s after sound 24, the town reloaded 3.06 s after the fade-out ends (live black 3.40 s from the last lit pen at 73.33, town at 76.73; the fade runs 16 x 10 VBLs from 71.00); keys (queued_keys) [C]: presses and releases queue in the input port, each sound drains it, a key in a sound ends it at a step, a line takes one queued event; the speech in the Amiga's own line breaks (game 0xc68a..). s153 live at 60 fps with sound (capture_s153_sounds.md) [C]: h77 +0xcfe waits a WaitTOF before each blit (blit_vbl), so the ghosts land one a frame, the arm the frame sound 1 ends, portrait 0 one frame later, each portrait one frame before its sound 21 (first ghost -> arm 0.25 s with six members); a click is two input events (the press ends a line, the release the next); an event after a sound has already been cut stays queued (the player reads one message a step). Disk waits refitted s153 on that run with the new sound holds: final.pic 3.50 s after 22's hold, guild.dat 6.09 s after 24's, the town 3.47 s after the fade-out (s130's run: 3.06).

The default h90 +0x10 (a 7-tick beep) serves 1, 2, 6, 7, 9, 11-14, 24, 26, 28, 29. 30 is not a table entry: the combat sparkle's script h90 +0x299, which h89 +0x1cc plays directly (s133; 2 steps, 3 + 1 ticks). 31 is not a table entry either: h90 +5, which h89 +0xd2 plays directly (s134; 1 step, A 0x22d volume 15, 3 ticks): the spell list's tone after each pick. 32 is not a table entry (s141): h89 +0xe0 plays the default h90 +0x10 directly (the dungeon wall's beep, map_message.sounds; the same script as 1).
